Lina M.: Heads-up: three partners and marketplace flagged identical mid-market accounts this morning. Need a clear claim-first rule to avoid duplicates.

Carlos T.: Which accounts?

Lina M.: Orbitix, GreenFold, FedProcurement. Proposal: SI claim wins when (a) si_referral=true OR (b) partner_oppty_id present OR (c) partner_requested_intro_ts within 7d. Else marketplace/SDR owns.

Priya S.: 7d makes sense for SIs. Add requirement: partner must attach an evidence link (email thread or ticket) else claim is invalid. Prevents grabby claims.

Carlos T.: Agree. For marketplace we should also tag `marketplace_trial=true` when checkout originates there. That helps prioritization and renewal handoffs.

integrations-bot: Draft webhook: POST /webhooks/lead-intake v1. Sample: {"account":"Orbitix","contact":"s.khan@orbitix.com","ref_source":"marketplace","si_partner_id":null,"partner_oppty_id":"","marketplace_trial":true,"lead_intake_ts":1719060000} 

Lina M.: Also require enrichment step (email verification + role/title normalized) before sending to SI. Partners complained about noisy contacts. Nightly enrichment ok.

Priya S.: Ops split: Partnerships owns partner-id mapping sheet; Partnership Ops handles exceptions; Sales Ops owns routing rules. Weekly triage report: overlaps by partner, avg handoff time, number of rejected claims.

Carlos T.: Add audit trail for each handoff (claimer, evidence link, ts). Retain 120 days. :mag: 

Lina M.: Implementation plan: 1) Add CRM fields: ref_source, si_partner_id, partner_oppty_id, partner_requested_intro_ts, marketplace_trial, preferred_owner (computed). 2) Webhook + validation. 3) Canary with top EMEA SIs for 2 weeks. 4) Collect partner feedback loop (3 partners).

Priya S.: I'll draft the SFDC field mapping and an automation playbook. Carlos take webhook + audit hooks?

Carlos T.: On it. I'll file INT-331 for webhook + audit + field additions.

integrations-bot: Created INT-331 (https://redwood.example/t/INT-331). Reminder set for 1719063600 to check canary metrics.

Lina M.: Great. Back here with PR links and the partner-id sheet by EOD tomorrow.

Priya S.: Thanks all.

Carlos T.: Filing follow-up calendar invite for post-canary review.
